plan: In Cycles 1-4, I will maximize Wallet income by drafting Characters that generate Crypto and trash weak cards from my starting deck, specifically Basic Encryption and Shyte-Coins as better options emerge. This foundational economy will support my strategies in future Cycles. From Cycle 5 to 8, I will balance aggressive strategies, engine development, Server Restore, and VP collection while adapting to the dynamics of Locations. Starting at Cycle 9, I will emphasize aggressive attacks on the opponent's Servers and prioritize acquiring high-value VP cards. (Schedule: economy through Cycle 4, balanced midgame Cycles 5-8, Chaos from Cycle 9, VP from Cycle 9.)
